chunks.arabic_text: ٢ - الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، الْأَصْبَهَانِيُّ، كَاسُولَا، أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ. حَدِيثُهُ يُعْرَفُ تُرًا وَيُنْكَرُ أُخْرَى. وَيَجُوزُ أَنْ يُخْرَجَ شَاهِدًا.

translations.en: 2 – Al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, al-Isbahānī, Kasulan, Abū Muḥammad. His ḥadīth is sometimes recognized, and other times denied. It is permissible to bring him out as a witness.

en.summary: This biographical note from al-Ghada'iri’s *Kitab al-Du'afa* characterizes Al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad al-Isbahānī as a narrator of mixed reliability, whose status fluctuates between acceptance and rejection. Consequently, his narrations are deemed suitable for citation as a supporting witness (*shahid*) to strengthen other evidence, rather than serving as an independent primary proof (*hujjah*) in legal derivations.
en.seo_question: What is the reliability status of Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Isbahani in Shia hadith sciences?
